title: Kazdikes: Eggplant and Feta Burekas Pouches
subtitle: crisp gathered pastry parcels
description: Crisp Bulgarian-style pastry pouches gathered like little purses and filled with roasted eggplant, feta and a mild semi-hard cheese. They freeze well for up to a month.

steps.text: Make the dough: mix the flour, salt and baking powder in a large bowl. Add the butter and rub in with your hands to small crumbs. Add the oil and milk and knead only until the dough is even. Shape into a ball, wrap in cling film and refrigerate for at least 3 hours, or overnight.
Make the filling: mix the roasted eggplant, feta, mild semi-hard cheese and 2 beaten eggs in a bowl.
Preheat the oven to 180°C and line a tray with baking paper.

Flour the work surface. Divide the dough into 6 parts and roll each to 1/2 cm thick. Sprinkle with a little flour and cut 12 cm rounds. Place a teaspoon of filling in the centre of each round and gather the edges up around it. Pinch the folds together firmly so they do not open. Thread a toothpick across the pouch to hold the folds and place on the tray. Repeat with the remaining dough.
Brush the pastries with 1 beaten egg mixed with 1 tablespoon of water and sprinkle with sesame seeds.
Bake for 20-25 minutes until golden. When cooled, remove the toothpicks.
